His lectures on science and culture earned him great esteem during the latter half of the 19th century. [ 1 ] Life [ edit ] Du Bois-Reymond was born in Berlin and spent his life there. His father was a poor immigrant from Neuchâtel , and his mother was a Berliner of prominent Huguenot origin. Emil had two sisters and two brothers, of whom one, Paul (2 December 1831 – 7 April 1889), became a distinguished mathematician. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] Educated first at the French College in Berlin, du Bois-Reymond enrolled in the University of Berlin in 1838.
